urdu: نوابزادہ اللہ نواز خان کو خیبر پختونخوا کی قانون ساز اسمبلی کا پہلا خطیب کب منتخب کیا گیا؟
english: When was Nawabzada Allah Nawaz Khan elected as the first speaker of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Legislative Assembly?
roman_1: Nawabzada Allah Nawaz Khan ko Khyber Pakhtunkhwa ki qanoon saaz assembly ka pehla khateeb kab muntakhib kiya gaya?
roman_2: Nawabzada Allah Nawaz Khan ko Khyber Pakhtunkhwa ki qanoon saaz assembly ka pehla khateeb kab chuna gaya?
roman_3: Nawabzada Allah Nawaz Khan ko Khyber Pakhtunkhwa ki qanoon saaz assembly ka pehla khateeb kab elect kiya gaya?
